slides.texte_overlay:
the small daily wins that
quietly rebuild your confidence

making your bed

make your bed as soon as you get up. it's the first task you finish each day, and that tiny win tells your brain you're someone who truly follows through.

keeping one promise

keep one small promise to yourself every day, like a walk or a glass of water. every kept promise slowly builds real trust in yourself, one ordinary day at a time.

finishing something

finish one small task you've been avoiding: an email, a call, a tidy drawer. crossing it off feels so much better than the quiet dread of leaving it there.

learning something new

learn one new thing every day in 5 minutes: a word, a painting, a moment in history. growing a little every day is the most reliable source of quiet confidence.

slides.texte_overlay:
moving your body

move for at least twenty minutes every day: a walk, a stretch, a dance in your kitchen. a body that feels good makes it much easier to feel good about yourself.
